content.text: Based on the image, to wipe the stain off the table, in which way should the robot gripper move? Choices: A. Move down to pick up the tissue, then move down to the table, then horizontally, as shown by the yellow curve. B. Move down to the table and then up, as shown by the red line. C. Move down to the table and then horizontally, as shown by the green line. D. None of the above. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
